teaser: Three paper plates still have frosting on them when the last parent leaves the birthday party, and you are the one scraping them into the trash because no one else will. Life path 9 is called the Humanitarian, and you cross it as an INFP, a personality type built on feeling and principle before proof. The particular shape here is a compassion that runs wide but drains quietly — moved by every stranger, worn by every detail. You give without being asked, then wonder, later, who gave to you.
